title: Japanese Chicken Tagine
description: A fusion dish that combines Indian and Japanese flavors. Marinated chicken is cooked in a flavorful tagine with aromatics and served over a bed of steamed jasmine rice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, garam masala, and tagine spice mix. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the rice vinegar and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over steamed jasmine rice, garnished with sliced scallions.
